title: Progesterone Therapeutic Regimen Plus Statins in Young Women With Early Endometrial Carcinoma and Atypical Endometrial Hyperplasia

sections.abstract: To explore the treatment efficacy of Progesterone Therapeutic Regimen Plus Statins in patients with atypical endometrial hyperplasia (AEH) and early endometrial carcinoma (EEC) for conservative treatment.
